fix the bug, and add or run tests.

raw_diff:
diff --git a/app/auth.py b/app/auth.py
index e12ab80..f24bb71 100644
--- a/app/auth.py
+++ b/app/auth.py
@@ -12,8 +12,10 @@ class LoginValidator:
     def validate(self, email: str, password: str | None) -> None:
         if not email or "@" not in email:
             raise ValidationError("INVALID_EMAIL")
-        if password is None:
+        if password is None or not password.strip():
             raise ValidationError("INVALID_PASSWORD")
         if len(password) < 8:
             raise ValidationError("PASSWORD_TOO_SHORT")
 
diff --git a/tests/test_auth.py b/tests/test_auth.py
index 842aa0a..fa70f93 100644
--- a/tests/test_auth.py
+++ b/tests/test_auth.py
@@ -21,6 +21,14 @@ def test_login_rejects_missing_password():
     with pytest.raises(ValidationError):
         validator.validate("user@example.com", None)
 
+def test_login_rejects_empty_password():
+    validator = LoginValidator()
+    with pytest.raises(ValidationError, match="INVALID_PASSWORD"):
+        validator.validate("user@example.com", "")
+
+def test_login_rejects_blank_password():
+    validator = LoginValidator()
+    with pytest.raises(ValidationError, match="INVALID_PASSWORD"):
+        validator.validate("user@example.com", "   ")
